SV-11690.title: Dashboard link sits after Reports and is the first screen after login
Login does not open the Dashboard; users land as in Production
SV-11690.refs: Dashboard PRD v52 (Oct 20,2026),Story 1: S1-R3,S1-R8,S1-N2; SV-11584.,Exact quotes:,S1-R3: “Logging in does not open the dashboard,for any user. After login the user goes where production sends them today,to the first of these that applies: the page they were trying to reach (a link they followed,or the page they were on when their session expired); otherwise the last page they visited,unless it was Work Orders or the dashboard,and only if they can still open it; otherwise the first page their permissions allow,which for most users is Work Orders (SV-11584).”,S1-R8: “A user who lacks the permission in S1-R6 and enters the dashboard address directly is redirected to Work Orders rather than shown an error page. Where any user lands after logging in is S1-R3.”,S1-N2: “A user with the Reports permission is not sent to the dashboard when they log in; they land as S1-R3 describes. The only way login ends on the dashboard is a link to it that the user followed.”
